notes.title: The Infinite Black - Expansion!
notes.content:
Big news today for The Infinite Black!

Due to overwhelming popular demand we have canceled the new game and will instead remaster the original with an expansion pack!

The expansion will add new features, content, and a modern interface built with our 3D game engine!

Bring your questions to the developer live stream!
Saturday, June 24th at 5:00pm US-Central time
http://www.SPELLBOOK.TV

notes.title: Holiday Client Update!
notes.content:
We've listened to your feedback and made a few improvements to the Windows, Mac, and Linux desktop clients! Additionally there are several more things in progress that will be ready by late December. Details to come at www.Spellbook.com soon!

In today's client patch many art assets have been updated and replaced with desktop in mind, and significant improvements were made to performance that will help save battery on laptops.

Many item display and map refresh bugs were also fixed.

We'll be running a Double BlackDollar Sale and holiday PvP event all weekend! 

Also be sure to check out our new tutorial gameplay video later today!

notes.title: Launched Today!
notes.content:
After a year in development we've finally launched the Steam desktop version of The Infinite Black!

Thank you everyone for your support and enthusiasm!

You can find a basic tutorial here: https://www.spellbook.com/tib/tutorial.php

We also have many [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/489000/guides] Steam Guides[/url] written by other players!

New players can join any server and should try to find a Corporation as soon as possible. Corporations will help you out, and offer protection in the depths of space!

You can also play from your mobile phones -- Just search the app store!

We have moderators in chat 24/7 who can answer questions, and we're always available by email at Contact@Spellbook.com
